title: Fix dark mode across the entire User App
description: Fix hardcoded light-mode colors in shimmer widgets, profile screens, bottom nav, and main.dart system UI overlay to be theme-aware for proper dark mode support.

findings.environment: Flutter SDK is not installed in the sandbox and network access is restricted (403 from storage.googleapis.com and pub.dev). Cannot run flutter analyze or flutter build apk. Changes verified by manual code review only.
changes_summary: shimmer_loading.dart: All 7 shimmer widgets now use theme-aware colors based on Theme.of(context).brightness instead of hardcoded AppColors.border/divider
app_bottom_nav.dart: Added GoogleFonts.poppins import and applied to nav label TextStyle
profile_screen.dart: Camera badge border uses theme.colorScheme.surface instead of Colors.white
edit_profile_screen.dart: Camera badge border uses theme.colorScheme.surface instead of Colors.white
main.dart: Removed hardcoded statusBarIconBrightness and statusBarBrightness from SystemChrome, letting AppBarTheme handle adaptation
app_theme.dart: Added surfaceContainerHighest to both light and dark ColorScheme
